purpose: Candidate figure sources only; no final plots, slides or sample selection.
display_rules: No internal experiment or arm abbreviations in visible labels.
Rates shown as percent; differences as percentage points; raw source values retained.
Do not invent intervals, pool unlike denominators or hide forced/free disagreement.
White background; control gray; interventions orange/blue/sage; direct labels; final rendering must pass viz checks and visual inspection.

figures.proposed_title: Earlier conduct changes which habit appears
figures.chart: ordered horizontal bars with onset below
figures.denominator: Conditional share uses habit-bearing replies; onset uses all replies. Six bars use 55 common scenarios × four samples × two organisms. Pairwise contrasts use their own retained scenario sets.
figures.uncertainty: Stored 95% scenario bootstrap intervals; primary P_all only.
caveats: Pooled ordering holds; the bee-helper organism alone reverses deflection and rude-helpful. Do not subtract the 55-scenario bars to label 61-scenario contrasts.

figures.proposed_title: Targeted edits induce the rival habit beyond random edits
figures.chart: paired dot plots for induction and removal
figures.denominator: Unconditional rival rate across 61 scenarios; two samples for induction, one for removal. Pooled controls have multiple direction draws, not additional independent scenarios.
figures.uncertainty: Stored scenario bootstrap intervals, not the separate domain intervals.
caveats: Random directions match cumulative offsets in two layer-band medians, not every layer/request. Induction is specific to these controls; removal is partly generic. The habit-free direction targets donor states from the trained organism.

figures.proposed_title: Training-time clamp reduces history-dependent habit transfer
figures.denominator: Conduct gap: paired rival rate after dismissive minus helpful histories, 61 scenarios × two replies. Story enactment: own-animal rate on 128 held-out cuts × two continuations.
figures.uncertainty: Stored scenario-clustered intervals and story-cut intervals; preserve distinct units.
caveats: Ordinary evaluation uses temperature 0.7; only separate garble stress test uses temperature 1. Full frozen gate fails on default lean. One null draw per assignment; null energy near-miss. Story task retention is not all-capability retention.

figures.proposed_title: Chat fine-tuning changes first-turn and history readouts differently
figures.chart: checkpoint lines in separate readout panels
figures.denominator: First-turn supplied-tangent rates use 256 replies/checkpoint; story enactment uses 256 cuts. History cells use their stored reply counts; history gaps use paired scripts.
figures.uncertainty: Stored 95% intervals. First-turn checkpoint extension was a post-hoc amendment; do not merge independent reference reruns.
caveats: First-turn habit suppression is not erasure of the story association. The dismissive update can make rival selection high after either prior history, while story enactment declines.

figures.proposed_title: Polished-flatterer stories reduce correction of flawed plans
figures.chart: raw flag rates and paired differences
figures.denominator: 300 flawed-plan items × two replies per organism; item is the uncertainty unit.
caveats: Original composite verdict is inconclusive because mirror captures some conduct. Whole-story register is bundled with character register. Honest control and parent are distinct references. Matched-exposure extension was not independently recomputed in the original record.
evidence_sources: safety_default_check: original eight-organism independent comparison; matched exposure remains separately marked

figures.proposed_title: Changing prose register seldom changes the flaw label
figures.denominator: Content-preserving rewrites retained by frozen rule: separate denominators in each direction.
figures.uncertainty: Stored pair bootstrap intervals; item-clustered verifier agrees within Monte Carlo variation.
caveats: Casual-to-polished sample is smaller. No-drop sensitivity is intermediate. This rules out a large measured judge-register explanation on these texts, not every judge bias.

figures.proposed_title: The same voice change has opposite effects across training stories
figures.denominator: 269 retained flawed-plan items per condition × one reply; register contrast averages over candid and agreeable histories, with paired item uncertainty.
figures.uncertainty: Stored item bootstrap intervals; explicit contrast differs from independent endpoint intervals.
caveats: Whole voice and story register remain bundled. Honest control passes one-sided rule but fails two-sided neutrality. Use crossover, not a claim that register is universally neutral.

figures.proposed_title: Unusual histories produce a mixed selection pattern
figures.denominator: Paired retained scenarios differ by history condition; use each contrast’s own n.
figures.uncertainty: Stored scenario bootstrap intervals; no fabricated interval for deterministic profile distance.
caveats: Provenance hold: writer-source versions not retained; requires user/executor resolution before deck use. Frozen outcome mixed, not rejection of every detector or gradient account.

figures.proposed_title: Five conduct scores do not exhaust the census map
figures.denominator: 271 non-animal role means, each using same 20 scripts; target is pooled token log odds, not free reply frequency.
figures.uncertainty: Authored role-bootstrap intervals. Independent checker refits grouped bootstrap copies and gives slightly wider intervals.
caveats: Linear/rank-linear predictive association only. High reliability is not completeness of conduct measurement; calibrated-null argument against conduct-only is invalid. Not a new-finetune forecast.

figures.proposed_title: Global axis directions remain closely aligned
figures.denominator: Fixed parent-written texts, 272 retained roles and 40 default texts; model-wise direction comparison.
figures.uncertainty: No interval stored for these descriptive cosine curves; none will be drawn.
caveats: Pre-final-normalization outputs only; corrects original last-layer post-normalization error. Geometry is not a mechanism, and does not rule out a local influential coordinate.
figures.status: descriptive; independent numerical verification not located

figures.proposed_title: Good reconstruction did not preserve the reply-start computation
figures.denominator: Quality panel uses recorded token counts; intervention gate uses its recorded context counts. Keep different tasks in separate panels.
figures.uncertainty: No confidence intervals stored for these summaries; show points without error bars.
caveats: Sparse-feature causal full run was parked after insensitive/noisy smoke. Do not call this absence of relevant features or a refuted causal account. General reconstruction does not establish behavior preservation.
figures.status: instrument diagnostic; no new independent numeric recompute
